Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Heard Mr. Siddhartha Singh and Mr. 
P.S. Bisht, Advocates for the petitioner. 
Issue notice to the respondent, 
returnable at an early date, by registered 
post, acknowledgment due. 
List this matter on 27.11.2019. 
In the meantime, it is provided that in 
case any application for adjournment of the 
case is moved by the petitioner, learned 
Court below shall consider the same for 
grant of adjournment till 27.11.2019 only. 
 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 
Arpan 22.10.2019

WPMS No.3260 of 2019
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Nandan Arya, Advocate, for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Siddhartha Sah, Advocate, for the 
respondent.
Mr. Ahrar Baig, Advocate, for the 
respondent.
The newly inducted learned counsel for 
the petitioner is to file his rejoinder affidavit, 
despite of the order dated 29.08.2022.
He prays for and is granted ten days time, 
by way of a last opportunity, to file rejoinder 
affidavit, lest failing which, the interim order 
already granted stands vacated.
For the aforesaid period, till he files the 
rejoinder affidavit, the interim order dated 
22.10.2019, would continue to operate till the 
next date of listing.
Put up in the week commencing 
06.11.2023.
Accordingly, IA No.14453 of 2023, would 
stand disposed of. 
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 03.10.2023
